control_flow_notes: Phase 2 names the remaining large functions, separates reused variable roles and restructures input/pagination/search/runtime branches. Integer widths, legacy wraparound, shared stack regions and save/state layouts remain fixed. Shared cleanup and wizard-backtracking labels are retained by purpose.
identifier_notes: All 446 function definitions are free of recovered temporary/local/label names. Phase 3 is identifier substitution only: 249 functions, 1516 variables/parameters and 54 labels. Unknown SDK internal fields and ignored ABI arguments remain explicitly marked. Existing storage reuse and uninitialized behavior are not repaired.
